prompt:
PROJETO: Releitura de The Elder Scrolls Arena, dark fantasy painterly game sprites. ONE giant Spider exemplar from original SPIDER@.CFA, not Frostbite spider of Skyrim. Reference1 tmp/spider-review/original-identity.png and reference2 SPIDER3.CFA.png show original identity; reference3 Arena_Combat_minotaur_v01.png shows APPROVED PAINTERLY FINISH only, do not copy its subject.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 separate authored drawings, 1536x1024 landscape. Same spider and same camera in all cells. TRUE LATERAL BATTLE facing RIGHT with slight elevated three-quarter depth to read the far legs. Ground body low and horizontal. Original: brown/rust chestnut chitin, black-brown undersides and joint tips, restrained gray highlights; oval rounded abdomen BEHIND, smaller compact cephalothorax IN FRONT, eight long thin angular segmented legs, four anatomical walking legs on each side attached ONLY to the cephalothorax, same attachment points between frames. Each of the EIGHT legs must remain traceable from root to tip, near4 and offset far4 with correct occlusion, not extra limbs attached to abdomen; TWO short mouth fangs/pedipalps only, distinctly tiny and not walking legs. No humanoid face, no glowing eyes, no armor, no enormous fangs, no fantasy spikes, no webs/venom/cloud/floor/shadow. Dark fantasy figurative painted realism, readable at ~130px wide, no pixel art. All drawings contain WHOLE spider and every legtip with at least40px transparent gap to neighbors. Individual spiders approx240px wide inside384px cells; generous top/bottom margins. No touching or clipping.
ROW1 four IDLE articulated weight/breath poses: neutral, abdomen/body subtly inhale while legtips grounded, exhale, neutral settle. Same size and support. ROW2 four ATTACK poses: low anticipation with front legs bent, front pair raised and head rising while six other legs remain grounded, forward short bite lunge at IMPACT with front pair lowered/reaching but still same anatomical8, return neutral. Do not move the whole drawing across cells: movement within pose, body support stable. ROW3 four HURT poses: neutral, small torso/leg recoil with all8 present, regaining support, returned guard. ROW4 four DEFEAT poses: legs start buckling, body sinks while eight legs curl inward, settles on ground with ALL8leg segments attached and coherently folded, stable curled dead spider on its belly/side, no dismemberment or gore. Same identity/proportion/leg lengths in every drawing; articulate joints, never stretch rubber limbs or rotate a static whole sprite. TRANSPARENT alpha, no text, grid, labels or background. Only these16 combat drawings, no walking or variants.
